title: {{grade}} test
exitHint: The test is saved and resumes from this task

intro.adaptive: The test picks tasks for your level and ends once your level is precise, usually before the limit.
intro.noFeedback: We do not show whether an answer is correct: this way the test cannot be gamed.
intro.keys: Keys 1–9 pick an option, Enter answers.

answer.order: Put the options in the right order
answer.orderHint: Drag a row, or select it with Space and move it with the arrow keys.
answer.picked: {{item}} selected. Use the arrows to move it, Space to drop.

protection.title: Verification block
protection.consent: Allow counting pastes and tab focus losses
protection.consentHint: Counters only, without content or screen recording. They do not affect your score but may suggest verification. The test works the same without consent.
protection.deadline: The block ends at {{date}}. Unanswered tasks count as incorrect.
protection.required: Confirm your {{grade}} result with a short timed block on the same topics. Protection signals do not lower your category and are hidden from employers.
protection.voluntary: Confirm your level with a short timed block. A matching result is shown to employers as verified. A mismatch does not change your category.
protection.mismatch: About {{expected, number}} correct answers were expected out of {{items, number}}, received {{correct, number}}. The block did not match the test.
protection.lowerText: Or start a new test for {{grade}} from scratch.
